evidence.title: GitHub - mui/material-ui: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design. Free forever. · GitHub

name: Material UI
summary: React component library implementing Google's Material Design, with around 50 components plus layout and lab extras.
description: Material UI implements Google's Material Design in React: inputs (autocomplete, button, checkbox, select, slider, switch, text field), data display (avatar, badge, list, table, tooltip), feedback (alert, dialog, progress, skeleton, snackbar), surfaces (accordion, app bar, card) and navigation (breadcrumbs, drawer, menu, pagination, stepper, tabs), plus layout primitives and lab components like masonry and timeline. Core functionality is extended by the separate MUI X suite for advanced use cases.
contains: around 50 components across inputs, data display, feedback, surface, navigation and layout
lab components include masonry and timeline
core extended by MUI X for advanced use cases
independent implementation of Google's Material Design
docs, examples and premium templates linked from the repo
